name: plan-cycle
description: From settled spec to executed work: PRD and issue publication, acceptance-check mapping, executor-ready implementation plans, plan and issue execution, tracker triage, plan queues, and mid-arc spec-drift reconciliation

interface.shortDescription: Turn a settled spec into published issues, executor-ready plans, and executed work
interface.longDescription: Nine skills covering one arc from settled intent to executed work. to-prd turns the current conversation and repo context into a PRD and publishes it to the project issue tracker. to-issues slices an existing plan, spec, or PRD into independently grabbable implementation issues and publishes them. acceptance-map turns a settled PRD, plan, issue, or design into a durable map of observable acceptance checks before implementation. implementation-planning writes an ordered plan an executor with no codebase context could follow exactly. execute-plan works that plan task by task. implement-issue works one agent-ready tracker issue per invocation, blockers verified first. triage creates, classifies, verifies, and moves issues through the tracker workflow. plan-queue sweeps a repo for its highest-leverage work, ranks it as a filename-tracked queue of executor-ready plans, and burns it down on authorization. spec-drift-reconcile surfaces what went stale when intent changed mid-arc and drives the fix through the owning skills.
